edits.inserted_utf8_lf:
For the local-ring comparisons in its Lemma 4.2.10 and Proposition 4.2.4,
\cite{pan-local-rings-project} supplies the fixed-determinant and
nilpotent-quotient connections and an integral matrix proof of flatness
for the nontrivial-character ring at five. The trivial-character branch
uses Taylor's componentwise statement; generic reducedness of the
unreduced whole special fiber is not asserted. The supplement retains
the other local branches and the stated completion hypotheses.
